To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the antioxidant activity of olive cake and leaves is higher than that of virgin olive oil and that the multilayer films containing olive cake and olive leaf extracts are promising materials to be used as food packaging.

(1) the antioxidant activity of olive leaves is higher in aqueous ethanol extract than in methanolic extract; (2) olive cake extract does not exhibit significant antioxidant capacity; (3) the incorporation of olive leaf extract into a polyethylene/paper film increases the scavenging ability of this material against free radicals; and (4) olive leaf extract does not migrate to food simulants.

the antioxidant activity of olive cake and olive leaf extracts was determined by DPPH and ORAC assays and that the most active extract was chosen and incorporated in multilayer films to evaluate their scavenging activity in an environment enriched in free radicals and that the limits of detection and the quantification of the main phenolic compounds in olive by products were established.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new antioxidant film based on olive by products.
the use of olive by products to obtain antioxidant extracts and their incorporation in food packaging to improve the antioxidant capacity of these materials.
the valorization of olive by products as source of natural antioxidants for food packaging applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
olive by products are an important source of phenolic compounds, with high antioxidant activity.
the antioxidant activity of OL is mainly due to the presence of oleuropein and Luteolin 6 C glucoside.
olive leaf extract could be used as antioxidant in multilayer films.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
olive by products could be used in the development of antioxidant films with potential applications in active food packaging.
OL extracts could be used as antioxidant additives in multilayer materials and as a natural additive in food industry.
olive by products are good source of phenolic compounds with antioxidant activity and can be used as natural antioxidant in food packaging.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the olive by products are a source of natural antioxidants which can be used as active ingredients for food packaging applications, in particular in the development of active films with antioxidant properties.
OL extract is a potential antioxidant source for the food industry, and that the antioxidant activity of OL can be incorporated into multilayer materials.
OL extracts could be used as a source of natural antioxidant in multilayer films.
